Author: Sadonia
Name: FateRunner
Punchline: Automated FATE farming for Bicolor Gemstones or leveling.
Description:
FateRunner finds FATEs, flies to them with vnavmesh, level syncs, and fights with Wrath Combo's Auto-Rotation (with BossMod AI dodging if you have it). It handles kill, boss, defend, hand-in and escort FATEs, keeps your chocobo out, and hops zones when yours runs dry.

Goals: a Bicolor Gemstone target (stopping before the 1,500 cap), run until stopped, or leveling, which picks zones for your job's level and moves up as you level.

Requires: vnavmesh, Wrath Combo. Optional: Lifestream, BossMod Reborn or BossMod.
